title: Fringe Benefits Tax Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would raise fringe benefits tax to reflect the proposed Medicare levy increase, as part of the package associated with DisabilityCare Australia funding.
The employer fringe benefits tax rate would increase from 46.5 to 47 per cent, combining the maximum income tax rate with the higher levy component.
The new rate would apply from the fringe benefits tax year beginning on 1 April 2014 and for later fringe benefits tax years.
changes: Section 6 of the Fringe Benefits Tax Act 1986 would be amended to set the higher rate.
The levy component reflected in the rate would become 2 per cent.
The amended rate would first apply for the tax year starting 1 April 2014.
summary.affected: Employers liable for tax on their fringe benefits taxable amount are affected.

speeches.speaker: Jenny Macklin
speeches.brief: Moved the Fringe Benefits Tax Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, explaining that the increase in the Medicare levy would require the fringe benefits tax rate to rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 April 2014, helping maintain tax-system integrity.

speeches.speaker: Anne McEwen
speeches.brief: The Selection of Bills Committee report recommended referring the Australian Jobs Bill 2013, Export Market Development Grants Amendment Bill 2013, Private Health Insurance Legislation Amendment (Base Premium) Bill 2013, and Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Bill 2013 to specific committees for inquiry by June 2013, and recommended not referring several other bills including the DisabilityCare Australia Fund Bill 2013 and related tax bills; the report was adopted.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
